jobs.description:
Are you an experienced roller operator with a passion for asphalt works?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced roller operator for our asphalt works.

What does your job involve?

  • You independently operate the road roller during asphalt works.
  • You ensure the correct and even compaction of the asphalt according to the required quality standards.
  • You take into account the temperature and composition of the asphalt and adapt your working method accordingly.
  • You work closely with machine operators, drivers and other colleagues in the asphalt crew.
  • You help monitor the quality of the road surface and ensure that the works are carried out accurately.
  • You work with modern machines, techniques and tools.
  • You carry out daily checks and help ensure the proper maintenance of the machine.
  • You depart daily from the depot in Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience as a road roller operator, preferably in asphalt or road construction.
  • You have a good understanding of asphalt compaction and understand the importance of using the correct rolling technique.
  • You have good technical insight and can work confidently with modern machinery.
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions.
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English.
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

Are you an experienced asphalt worker who enjoys rolling up your sleeves?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced asphalt worker to join our asphalt crew.

What does your job involve?

  • You assist the asphalt crew with the preparation, laying and finishing of hot-mix asphalt;
  • You help ensure the correct distribution and finishing of the asphalt;
  • You are responsible for touching up and finishing asphalt around joints and connections;
  • You help create a smooth and high-quality road surface;
  • You work closely with machine operators, roller operators, drivers and other colleagues on site;
  • You work with modern machinery, techniques and tools;
  • You depart daily from Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience in asphalt works, preferably as an asphalt worker;
  • You have knowledge of the different steps involved in laying and finishing hot-mix asphalt;
  • You are physically fit and enjoy active, hands-on work;
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions;
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English;
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

Are you an independent mechanic who enjoys working on technical projects and is not afraid of a new challenge?

Would you like to work on ships and join an environment where you are given a lot of responsibility and freedom?

For a growing company specialised in ship repair and technical maintenance, we are looking for a MARINE MECHANIC.

As a SHIP MECHANIC, your responsibilities will include:

  • Performing mechanical maintenance and repairs on ships;
  • Working on different vessels, both at the workshop in Ostend and on-site throughout West Flanders;
  • Starting on-site and working independently on the scheduled tasks;
  • Being responsible for the maintenance, dismantling and assembly of mechanical components;
  • Working on engines, drive systems, pumps and other mechanical installations;
  • Detecting mechanical faults and defects and providing suitable solutions;
  • Carrying out mechanical interventions and repairs;
  • Checking and testing installations after completing the work;
  • Actively thinking along with technical issues and independently looking for solutions.
As a MARINE MECHANIC in OSTEND, you recognise yourself in the following:

  • You have a technical education or background, preferably in industrial mechanics;
  • You speak Dutch OR English;
  • You have a valid driving licence B;
  • Previous experience in an industrial environment is preferred;
  • Experience in the maritime sector is a plus, but not an absolute requirement;
  • You can work independently and do not need constant supervision;
  • You are proactive and resourceful and know how to find solutions yourself;
  • You are willing to take responsibility.

For the strengthening of our team, we are looking for a truck driver with a Category C driving licence to operate our emulsion truck.

You will depart from our depot in Oostende and drive to various construction sites throughout West Flanders. In addition to the transport, you will also be responsible for the correct application and processing of the emulsion on site, meaning you will be active both behind the wheel and on the construction site.

Your responsibilities:

  • You transport emulsion from our depot in Oostende to various construction sites throughout West Flanders;
  • You are responsible for the correct and safe loading and unloading of emulsion;
  • You operate the emulsion truck's equipment and ensure the correct application of the emulsion;
  • You work both with machinery and manually during the processing of emulsion on site.



What do we expect from you?

  • You have a valid Category C driving licence.
  • Code 95 is NOT required.
  • You have good technical insight and are willing to learn how the emulsion truck operates and how emulsion is processed on site.
  • You speak and understand sufficient Dutch or English to communicate safely and smoothly with your colleagues.

Would you like to help build high-quality roads throughout West Flanders? Then we would love to hear from you!

For our client in the Veurne area, we are looking for a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN.

Our client is a well-known garage in Veurne with a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere. They are looking for a new colleague to join their team.

They are a well-established garage with a modern, clean and fully equipped workshop.

As a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN in the Veurne area, your responsibilities will include:

  • Working independently on cars and vans;
  • Carrying out technical and electrical maintenance on passenger cars and vans;
  • Performing diagnostics on vehicles;
  • Dismantling and repairing engines;
  • Replacing timing belts.
As a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN in the Veurne area, you meet the following requirements:

  • You have experience as a vehicle mechanic, preferably with experience as a diagnostic technician;
  • You are in possession of a valid category B driving licence;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client, we are looking for a PLASTERER.

As an all-round plasterer, you will be responsible for various plastering and finishing works. You will work on both interior and exterior projects and ensure a neat and high-quality finish every time.

Your responsibilities as a PLASTERER:

  • Carrying out plastering works;
  • Preparing surfaces;
  • Applying and finishing interior and exterior plaster;
  • Repairing and touching up existing plasterwork;
  • Finishing corners, edges and connections;
  • Working with spray cork;
  • Working with different materials and techniques;
  • Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish;
  • Working on different construction sites and projects.
This is you as a PLASTERER:

  • You have experience as a plasterer or renovation worker;
  • You can work independently, but also work well as part of a team;
  • You have an eye for detail and deliver a neat finish;
  • You are physically fit;
  • You speak Dutch or fluent Englisch;
  • You have a valid category B driving licence.

Join Magnax as a Mechanical Design Engineer – Robotics and help shape compact, high-performance actuators. You'll translate demanding motion requirements into manufacturable mechanical designs.
 
 

• Design mechanical solutions for robotic systems, from concept to production. 

• Create 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying industry standards and GD&T. 

• Perform mechanical calculations and design verification for performance, reliability, and durability. 

• Work with suppliers and subcontractors on components, processes, tolerances, materials, and specs. 

• Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and design improvements. 

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in the design and development of robotic systems, actuators, or precision motion systems.
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools.
   
 

•  

Strong understanding of robotics system requirements and performance specifications, with the ability to translate payload, speed, torque, force, power, accuracy and duty cycle into mechanical design requirements.
   
 

•  

Strong awareness of the latest trends and technologies in robotics, with a good understanding of emerging robotic architectures, actuation technologies, and motion solutions.
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent). You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48) or late shift (14u00 - 22u00).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 5u10 or 13u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this treatment, they make a real difference every day in the lives of patients with cancer and other serious diseases.

The company is growing fast and is looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

At Legend Biotech, as a Quality Control Support, you’ll have the chance to make a real difference.Your work will directly contribute to improving the lives of sick patients around the world.

Your responsibilities include:
	
• You assist with daily quality analyses and help ensure reliable test results.	
• You check, clean, and disinfect equipment, and manage lab materials and waste.	
• ou ensure safe and accurate sample transfers between departments.	
• You assist with various analyses in the labs.	
• You accurately log all your tasks in logs, forms, or the quality system.

	
• You have experience in Quality, preferably.	
• You live nearby Ghent and can easily commute to work, even without public transportation.	
• You speak English well.	
• You have a clean and accurate working style.	
• You collaborate well with others.	
• You are comfortable working with a laptop and MS-Office.	
• You are flexible and able to work in shifts.

For a customer in Peer we are looking for motivated employees in dayshift.

Do you have a good feeling for fashion? Are you available in dayshift? You are not allergic for dust? 

 

As sorting emplyee you have the following tasks:

• You have a passion for fashion and modern clothing.

• You sort the clothing based on size, quality and fashion

• You quality check the clothing

• You start with the simpeler tasks and gradually the difficulty will improve

• Keeping the work environment tight and clean

As sorting employee we are looking for this profile:

• No experience required, everything can be learned

• You dont have dust allergy

• You have a passion for fashion and modern clothing.

• You speak Dutch or English well.

• You are results-driven, stress-resistant, and flexible.

Are you a hands-on and service-minded professional who enjoys creating a welcoming and well-organised workplace? In this varied role, you will ensure the smooth daily operation of a modern international office while acting as a key contact for employees, visitors and external service providers.

 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.

With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

 

Description

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.
• Contribute to creating a professional, safe and pleasant working environment for all employees and visitors.
 

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.

Are you an organised and service-oriented professional who enjoys being at the heart of office life? In this part-time role, you will support the daily operations of a busy international office, ensuring employees and visitors enjoy a seamless and welcoming workplace experience.

 

Client Details

Our client is an internationally active organisation with offices across multiple countries. Their Brussels team operates in a professional, collaborative and multicultural environment where efficiency, excellent service and teamwork are key to success.

As the organisation continues to grow, they are looking for a reliable Office Operations Assistant to help maintain smooth day-to-day office activities and provide essential administrative support.

 

Description

• Act as the first point of contact for visitors, answering calls and welcoming guests professionally.
• Provide administrative support including data entry, document preparation, proofreading and reporting.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, catering arrangements and logistics for internal meetings and events.
• Manage office supplies, kitchen stock, consumables and general workplace organisation.
• Handle incoming and outgoing mail, deliveries and courier services.
• Support facilities-related requests and liaise with external suppliers when needed.
• Assist with access badge administration, workspace set-up and daily office inspections.
• Prepare the office for opening and help maintain a clean, organised and professional working environment.
 

• You have at least 1 year of experience in administration, office coordination, reception or workplace support.
• You are comfortable using Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word and Excel.
• You communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of French and/or Dutch is considered an asset.
• You are highly organised, proactive and able to multitask effectively.
• You have a strong service mindset and enjoy supporting both colleagues and visitors.
• You are hands-on and willing to assist with practical office and facilities-related tasks.
• You are reliable, discreet and able to work independently.
• You are available to work on-site in Brussels on a part-time basis, Monday to Friday from 9AM to 1PM.

jobs.occupation: Manager Consolidation and Reporting - Walloon Brabant
jobs.description:
A European industrial group operating in multiple countries is reinforcing its Group Finance structure and is hiring a Consolidation & Group Reporting Manager (or Expert).

The group works with complex operations, numerous entities and a strong international footprint, requiring robust reporting frameworks and high-quality consolidated financials.

Their offices are located in Walloon Brabant.

Jobomschrijving

You will lead the consolidation and reporting function, oversee IFRS compliance and safeguard the accuracy, consistency and timeliness of group accounts. As a key advisor to senior finance leadership, you will drive harmonisation of accounting practices and continuous improvement of the consolidation environment.

Key Responsibilities :

• Steer the monthly, quarterly and annual consolidation under IFRS
• Ensure quality and completeness of consolidated accounts (eliminations, minority interests, acquisitions/divestments…)
• Lead the preparation of the group's statutory financial statements and quarterly reporting
• Act as main point of contact for external auditors
• Participate to the migration to a new consolidation system (currently HFM)
• Develop reporting structures, dashboards and closing-process improvements
• Support M&A activities (PPA, integration, system setup)
• Collaborate closely with FP&A, treasury and local accounting teams
• Possibility to manage one consolidation analyst (depending on experience).

• Master's degree in Finance/Accounting; professional qualification (CPA, ACCA…) is an asset
• 6-12 years of experience in Consolidation within an international context
• Strong IFRS expertise and ability to handle complex accounting topics
• Rigorous, analytical and comfortable with tight deadlines
• Excellent communication with the ability to influence stakeholders across countries
• Fluent in English (French is a plus).

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?
As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage
• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently
• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages
• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries
• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

We are currently looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist, fluent in French and English, to join a team based in Brussels.

In this temporary assignment, you will play a key role in supporting the full recruitment cycle within the professional services sector. Your responsibilities will include sourcing talent, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and ensuring an efficient and positive hiring process.

Client Details

A professional services organisation based in Brussels.

Description

As a recruiter your responsibilities are:

 

• Source and attract candidates using various recruitment channels.
• Screen and shortlist applicants based on job requirements.
• Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers.
• Maintain and update recruitment databases and records.
• Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Provide support in contract preparation and onboarding processes.
• Collaborate with the HR team to meet recruitment goals.
• Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

• Bilingual in French and English (mandatory)
• Previous experience in recruitment is required
• Enjoys daily interaction with people while also appreciating administrative tasks
• Available immediately
• Temporary contract, with a potential opportunity for a permanent position

Do you enjoy staying active and feel at home in a logistics environment? As a Logistics employee, you ensure that our finished products are shipped smoothly and correctly to our customers.

• You ensure the correct dispatch of finished products to the loading dock.

• You handle goods safely and efficiently using a forklift truck and electric pallet truck. 
• You work closely with your colleagues to keep the logistics flow running smoothly. 
• You help maintain a clean, safe and organised workplace.

• You are a team player who enjoys achieving results together with colleagues. 
• You always comply with safety and quality standards. 
• You have initial experience with transport documentation or are motivated to learn.

jobs.occupation: Head of Sales - Regulated B2B Services
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international service provider operating across multiple countries in Europe and beyond. With several hundred employees in Belgium and a strong position in its market, the company is currently entering a new phase of growth driven by innovation, strategic partnerships and evolving customer needs.

To support this development, our client is looking for a Head of Sales Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the Managing Director and sitting on the local leadership team, you will lead the commercial function, shape the sales strategy, develop key customer relationships and manage a team of experienced sales professionals.Commercial Strategy & Growth

• Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Belgian market.
• Translate business objectives into clear action plans and measurable KPIs.
• Identify growth opportunities and drive business development initiatives.
• Monitor commercial performance, sales activity and pipeline development.
• Contribute to the overall business strategy as a member of the management team.

Team Leadership

• Lead, coach and develop a team of 3 sales professionals.
• Foster a high-performance culture focused on customer value and commercial results.
• Support the team in managing complex sales cycles and strategic accounts.
• Ensure effective collaboration across departments.

Key Account Management

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with major national customers.
• Manage executive-level conversations with key decision-makers.
• Lead commercial negotiations and contract discussions.
• Act as a trusted partner for strategic clients and stakeholders.

Marketing Coordination

• Coordinate local marketing initiatives in collaboration with international colleagues.
• Manage relationships with external marketing partners and agencies.
• Support brand visibility, customer engagement and commercial campaigns.
• Contribute to market positioning and business growth initiatives.

What matters most is your ability to lead teams, build commercial strategies and drive business results in a B2B environment.

You bring:

• A proven track record in a B2B commercial leadership role.
• Experience managing and developing sales teams.
• Strong commercial acumen and strategic thinking skills.
• Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Experience working with large accounts and complex customer environments.
• The ability to build structure, set priorities and drive execution.
• A hands-on mindset combined with strong leadership qualities.
• Curiosity and the willingness to learn and understand a new industry.
• Fluency in Dutch, French, English
